title: Microsoft Purview DLP: Security Copilot insights on policy coverage (GCC, GCC High, DoD)
summary: The briefing passes: the roadmap facts, preview prerequisites, licensing background and plugin controls are supported. It correctly distinguishes the planned government-cloud release from current commercial guidance. The owner plugin-settings path stops on the correct page but should extend to the availability choice.
